title: The Communal Death
summary: A man is found poisoned in a bunker.
method: The killer exploited blind spots in the camera to carry out the murder. The poisoned coffee was made by the killer and handed to the victim from above the door. The camera also doesn't show if the door had been opened or not.
motive: The victim was the main one bankrolling the commune. He was upset at what the commune had become and wanted to withdraw his funding. The commune was important to the killer due to his doomsday fears.
killer: One of the other people in the commune, the one who stocked up on weapons.
